closed-volume.proposal: actual verified closed physical union volume divided by .12; withhold on unverified/open/cut geometry or unresolved overlap; never double-count compound intersections or cosmetic layers

inert.proposal: zero fuel; keep screening, breakage, mass/support intent and retirement explicit

leaf-area.proposal: one native body plus its existing upper extension: total nonduplicate physical panel area times .45, once per portal/sign; hardware separate/inert

top-area.proposal: actual upward projected physical area times 1; retain each real slab/tread, apertures and .12 m slab geometry; never add absent cells

wall-area.proposal: one primary remaining physical wall/closure area at .16 m native depth times 1; never two faces; partition versus clapboard uses the selected existing profile

weather-area.proposal: actual exposed upward weather-face area times 1; remove buried/duplicate coverage by actual triangles, never bounding-box area

withheld.proposal: No finite assignment, including no automatic zero or timber default
